title: Test-phase redirects
statement: Given finite Turing machines $M_V$ and $M_I$ over the Boolean alphabet, define a partial redirect from a test phase and a state of that phase to a phase-state pair. Every anchor state redirects to the identity phase in its initial cleaning state for $M_I$; an identity singleton state redirects to rewind-start; a rewind singleton state redirects to the copy sweep state; the copy done state redirects to call with its initial rewind state and Boolean value true; and a call singleton state redirects to verdict-left. All other phase-state pairs have no redirect.
hypotheses_covered: two finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
